findings.highlight: we’re people that go under the radars of the normal Masters
findings.evidenceJa: 僕は普通のマスターたちのレーダーに映らない存在なんだよ
findings.governingReading: Shinji claims that he personally does not register on ordinary Masters’ radar.
findings.explanation: The English changes the singular speaker into an unspecified plural group and produces an unnatural plural “radars.”

findings.highlight: it’ll be a problem if we don’t do something about it fast
findings.evidenceJa: 早めに叩かないと厄介らしい
findings.governingReading: Rider reportedly says the temple threat must be struck early before it becomes troublesome.
findings.explanation: “Do something about it” weakens the specific proposal to attack.
